title: Human methylarginine sites, v1.4.2 (PTM_Pipeline)
description: The human protein arginine methylation sites of DeAngelo, Silverstein & Shechter, Cell Chem Biol 33:1404-1421 (2026), with the code that builds them and the Methylarginine Site Explorer website. v1.4.2 has 11,632 sites on 4,439 proteins, and 2,396 lower-confidence sites, as v1.4.1, and adds a layer of annotation, maps of the cell: where the methylated proteins sit by four maps beside the Human Protein Atlas (the Human Cell Map, organelle IP, chromatin probability, and the nuclear speckle, lamina and PML-body proteomes), each tested against the proteins it places and within PaxDb abundance deciles, and where the RNAs bound by proteins with eCLIP data gather (APEX-seq, nuclear-body APEX2-seq, TSA-seq and Hi-C subcompartments); on the website, selections open on the Overview, where every section is retested on them. v1.4.1 keeps every site and value of v1.4.0 and repeats each protein-level over-representation test within PaxDb protein abundance deciles (Mantel-Haenszel), beside the test it repeats. v1.4.0 kept every site of v1.3.1 and added 31 from Lu et al. 2024 (HeLa). Five layers of annotation sit beside the sites without adding, removing or moving any: PRMT knockouts, knockdowns and inhibitors from five studies, each site called at twofold and q < 0.05 and by the published criteria; cancer genetics (DepMap 24Q4 and PRISM 24Q2 dependencies of the methylated proteins, and the changes at each methylarginine in TCGA tumours and DepMap cell lines); Reactome 97 pathways; PaxDb 6.1 protein abundance; and experiments on the methylation of a site or protein, curated from the literature. releases/v1.4.2/CHANGES.md says what v1.4.2 changed since v1.4.1; the earlier versions (v1.4.1, v1.4.0, v1.3.1, v1.3.0, v1.2.0, v1.1.0 and the published v1.0.0) are also included.
